messages:
Mia: heads up — ptq-canary v3 on raven-lite is showing a 2.8% funcall parse failure rate vs 0.1% on fp16 baseline. First observed after int8 quant profile enabled. Sample: ```{"action": "open", "args": [1, 2],} some extra text```
Rahul: ugh trailing comma + random suffix. Is it always a suffix or sometimes mid-json?
Carlos: pasted 3 snippets from logs: 
Carlos: ```
{"result": {"id":123}}

# human note
```
Jess: looks like model appends explanation after JSON sometimes. Our parser currently treats first newline as end-of-json which fails when suffix is appended without newline.
Anya: can we do soft-rescue: attempt ndjson split, then json5/coerce, fallback to regex trim after last `}`? tradeoff is latency.
Mia: measured: soft-rescue raises median latency from 83ms -> 120ms, p95 220ms -> 410ms. But reduces parse failures from 2.8% -> 0.12%.
Oliver: what's retry budget impact? retrying increases token cost and can amplify latency. Maybe prefer single-response repair over full retry.
Jess: propose heuristics:
Jess: 1) attempt simple rstrip after last `}` up to 1k chars
Jess: 2) if fails, try JSON5 coercion
Jess: 3) only if strict mode, fallback to retry w/ increased temperature damping
Carlos: sounds reasonable. We need canary config flags: `enable_soft_rescue=true/false` & `rescue_max_trim=1024`.
ci-bot: canary run 3777 finished. metrics: parse_fail_rate=2.8% -> 0.12% w/ soft_rescue; latency_median_increase=+44ms; see https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/3777 :white_check_mark:
Rahul: next steps: add rescue toggle to canary, run A/B with traffic-split 10/90 for 24h, collect hallucination/regression eval on toolcall intents.
Mia: opened PR and test plan: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ptq-rescue/compare — tagging @eng-ml for review :eyes:
Oliver: sgtm, adding to tomorrow standup
Mia: thanks all :tada:
